entries.title: Psalms 104:1
segments: In this psalm the majesty and goodness of God, as manifested in creation and providence, are set forth for the comfort and encouragement of his people.

entries.title: Psalms 104:2
segments: Light; the emblem of knowledge, truth, wisdom, purity, and blessedness.

entries.title: Psalms 104:3
segments: The waters; the waters above, that constitute the clouds.

entries.title: Psalms 104:4
segments: Spirits; or, winds; that is, God makes his ministering angels strong and mighty, like winds and lightning, to execute his will.  So the Greek version, which is followed by the apostle,
.  But many prefer to render the Hebrew, "Who maketh the winds his messengers, and the flaming fire his ministers."

entries.title: Psalms 104:5
segments: The perfections of God as displayed in the works of his hands, call for the united and unceasing praises of all intelligent creatures, and will be the theme of adoring gratitude for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 104:6
segments: The waters stood above the mountains; at the creation and at the deluge.

entries.title: Psalms 104:8
segments:
They go up--go down; or, The mountains ascend, the valleys descend. The reference will then be to the separation of the dry land from the sea, when, by God's command, the mountains and valleys took their appointed places. 
 
The sources and supply of water with which the earth abounds, are a manifestation of the wisdom, goodness, and power of God, which calls for the grateful and devout acknowledgments of all his people.

entries.title: Psalms 104:9
segments: They; the waters.

entries.title: Psalms 104:13
segments:
His chambers; his heavenly chambers in the clouds. 
 
  Satisfied; abundantly supplied, and made fruitful.

entries.title: Psalms 104:14
segments: The daily food and constant support of all creatures comes from God. he openeth his hand an supplieth the wants of every living thing.

entries.title: Psalms 104:16
segments: Trees of the Lord; of God's own planting.

entries.title: Psalms 104:19
segments: In the control and order of the elements and of the heavenly bodies, and in the instincts of animals which adapt them to the use and service of man, God shows his wisdom, power, and love, and lays men under special obligations to praise him.

entries.title: Psalms 104:21
segments: Seek their meat from God; are dependent upon him, and are supported by his care.

entries.title: Psalms 104:24
segments: Thy riches; the products of thy power and kindness.

entries.title: Psalms 104:27
segments: These wait all upon thee; look to thee for the supply of their wants.

entries.title: Psalms 104:30
segments: Thy Spirit; the author of natural and spiritual life.

entries.title: Psalms 104:31
segments: The works of the Lord are perfect and glorious, and a source of joy, not only to his people, but to himself.  All his works praise him, and his saints bless him.

entries.title: Psalms 104:32
segments:
It trembleth; before the power of God, as in volcanoes, earthquakes, and tempests. 
 
  They smoke; as mount Sinai at the giving of the law.

entries.title: Psalms 104:35
segments: The same glorious attributes of God which have furnished the world to be a residence for man, and provided so richly for the wants of all its inhabitants, will be manifested in the destruction of the wicked who oppose themselves to his righteous government.
